oneLiner: A warm 10–15 minute AI phone call with every applicant, not just the top 50 — so good people with bad resumes stop getting filtered out.

stages.name: Define what we're building
stages.goal: Agree exactly what the product does, who uses it, and what the demo shows.
known: Problem: resume screens cut ~900 of 1,000 applicants; some are strong people with weak resumes.
Every applicant gets a 10–15 minute voice call from an AI built on Bolna.
Flow: apply → land on hiring platform → AI calls → AI judges fit to JD and company → enrich applicant record + give a verdict.
Verdict scale: No / Maybe / Good / Amazing.
Also capture: fit for another role, general culture fit, looking for an internship.
Phone call only. No Google Meet, no video. The call has to feel perfect.
Opens upfront: “This is about your job application for [role] — can we do a 10-minute chat?”
Candidate can reschedule with the AI if now is a bad time.
Tone: warm and conversational, not a prickly HR screen.
Guardrail: politely cut in on long answers (“anything else in the next 20 seconds, then we’ll move on”), or ask a follow-up.
Reference for voice quality and intelligence: Wavelength.
open: Call everyone, or only ~400 who pass a resume filter? Raw thoughts say everyone; the PRD says filter first.
Warm story-led chat (raw thoughts) or structured 6 questions + 2 resume probes (PRD)?
Verdict: No / Maybe / Good / Amazing plus other-role, culture and internship flags (raw thoughts), or a 0–100 score and top-20% shortlist (PRD)?
Call length: 10–15 minutes (raw thoughts) or 6–8 minutes (PRD)?
What is the canvas — recruiter view of all applicants, a per-candidate story page, or something else?
What do judges see live in the demo?
How do candidates consent to an AI call, and does the AI say it is an AI?
Where do applicants come from — which hiring platform, or a CSV upload for the demo?
What exactly gets added to the applicant record after the call?

stages.name: Edge cases
stages.goal: List every way a call or the pipeline can go wrong, and decide how we handle each.
open: Starter list to review (not agreed yet): no answer / voicemail, wrong number, call drops midway, bad network.
Candidate rambles, goes silent, asks “are you a bot?”, gets upset, or tries to negotiate salary.
Candidate wants Hindi or another language; heavy accent; background noise.
Candidate reschedules, then misses the rescheduled slot.
Bolna limit of 2 calls at a time vs 1,000 applicants.

stages.name: System architecture + SLD
stages.goal: Design the whole system and draw the system-level diagram. Built with Fable.

stages.name: Build with subagents
stages.goal: Split the architecture into independent pieces and build them in parallel with subagents.

decisions.text: Phone calls only — no Google Meet, no video.
Calls open by stating plainly that it’s about the job application.
Process: define → edge cases → architecture + SLD (Fable) → build with subagents.
